_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Anjeun nyaéta Pamaén {player_id}, maén {num_rounds} puteran tina Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Anjeun boga ${pool} pikeun dibagi dina puteran ieu antara anjeun sorangan jeung Pamaén {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Nyieun tawaran: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Upama ditarima → Anjeun meunang $(pool - X), pamaén séjén meunang $X
  - Upama ditolak → Duaanana meunang $0
  - Conto: [Offer: $3]  atawa  'Kuring rasa ieu adil. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Ngadékékeun tawaran kalawan [Accept] atawa [Reject]
  - Conto: 'Éta katingali wajar. [Accept]'
            'Kahadéan. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Puteran {round_number} dimimitian! ---
Pamaén {proposer_id} minangka proposer, Pamaén {responder_id} minangka responder.
round.accepted: Pamaén {responder_id} ditarima! Puteran {round_number} meunang: Pamaén {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Pamaén {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Total anyar: Pamaén 0: ${total_0}, Pamaén 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Pamaén {responder_id} nolak tawaran! Puteran {round_number} meunang: Duaanana +$0. Total tetep: Pamaén 0: ${total_0}, Pamaén 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Nu ngajukeun kudu nyieun tawaran ngagunakeun format [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Jumlah tawaran kudu jumlah nu bener.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Teu aya tawaran ayeuna pikeun direspon.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder kudu ngalakonan [Accept] atawa [Reject] tawaran éta.

outcome.win: Pamaén {winner} meunang kalawan ${winner_total} total vs Pamaén {loser} nu ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Draw! Kadua pamaén réngsé kalayan ${total} total.
